module_title: Indigenous Formats, Rings, and Flexible Field Dimensions
introduction: Advanced questions test layout parameters for indigenous Indian sports (Kabaddi, Kho-Kho) along with boxing ring metrics, table tennis profiles, and flexible international boundary ranges.

core_concepts.title: Kabaddi and Kho-Kho Court Grids
core_concepts.description:
1. **Men's Kabaddi Court:** Measures **13 meters × 10 meters** (Women's standard measures 12 meters × 8 meters).
2. **Standard Kho-Kho Court:** Measures **27 meters × 16 meters** (The distance between the two poles/end-lines is exactly 24 meters).

core_concepts.title: Football and Field Hockey Outlines
core_concepts.description:
1. **International Football Field:** Length can range from 100 to 110 meters; width from 64 to 75 meters. (The standard premium blueprint typically matches 105 meters × 68 meters).
2. **Field Hockey Pitch:** Measures **91.40 meters × 55.00 meters** (equivalent to 100 Yards × 60 Yards).

core_concepts.title: Boxing Rings and Table Tennis Boards
core_concepts.description:
1. **Boxing Ring:** A square combat canvas. The interior dimensions can range dynamically from 4.9 meters to 6.1 meters (16 to 20 feet) square inside the ropes.
2. **Table Tennis Table:** Measures 2.74 meters (9 ft) in length × 1.525 meters (5 ft) in width, suspended 76 cm above the floor.

important_entities.name: Lona (Kabaddi Rule)
important_entities.significance: When a team manages to completely dismiss or send out all the players of the opposing team, it is defined as a 'Lona', which awards **2 extra bonus points** to the scoring team.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Unlike a cricket pitch which has an unyielding layout, soccer fields have official minimum and maximum ranges under FIFA rules. Don't look for a single rigid number; watch out for ranges or the premium standard option (105x68m).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Men's Kabaddi layout length is 13m (13x10), while the Women's layout drops to 12m (12x8).

exam_strategy_tips: A regular focus in Delhi Police and SSC CPO papers: 'What are the official dimensions of a standard men's Kabaddi court?' Answer: 13 meters × 10 meters.
